reviews.text: This is one of the best vets I've ever had the pleasure of going to. My two dogs have been going here for about 2 years and the quality of care has always been exceptional. The doctors and staff are incredibly knowledgeable, and their love for animals (and their humans) shines through. They will always go the extra mile to make sure both are as happy and healthy as possible, and I can't thank them enough, or recommend them more <3

An exceptional team! Highly competent! The veterinarians saved my dog ​​who was dying! The team managed to diagnose a rare disease and implemented the appropriate treatment! A clinic I highly recommend for its professionalism, expertise, and compassion.
Competent and lovely team

I am so happy that since moving to Paris, we have had the chance to discover Les Vétos Parisiens and Dr. Dos Santos. We have had quite a few health issues, but we have thankfully undergone several successful surgeries and today we continue to enjoy every day of our lives.

A huge thank you to Dr. Dos Santos and the entire clinic team for their attentiveness, professionalism, and kindness. Sonya sends her regards and thanks!

After numerous consultations and examinations, with no improvement despite visits to renowned clinics (FRE***, ADV***, VETi***), Dr. Cauvin and Dr. Michelland were finally able to find the right treatment for our little companions.

For Léa, Arthur, and Juju, we are eternally grateful. 🙏

Excellent service, the practice is great,
the doctor is very friendly and professional; she took great care of my little dog.
I highly recommend her.

If you're looking for an excellent veterinary clinic for your beloved pets, I recommend this place 10000%!

From the moment we arrived, we received a wonderful welcome. The receptionists are lovely, very kind, and always smiling. The clinic itself is truly beautiful: the decor is exquisite, the colors are gorgeous, and the atmosphere is extremely calm and serene, which greatly helps to soothe our furry friends.

A huge thank you to Dr. Lucile. She was simply fantastic with my cat from the very first minute! She is an incredibly gentle, attentive, and caring veterinarian. In addition to providing care, she perfectly guided and assisted me with all the necessary procedures and regulations for traveling with my cat.

Both of our appointments went extremely well. The team is extremely professional, responsible, and above all, they treat animals with immense love.

Go for it without hesitation, I highly recommend them!
Kind, professional and attentive. Top-notch!
Fantastic vet! Dr. Arielle Ciup was lovely and very patient with my dog, who is afraid of vaccines. She took the time to reassure her and put her at ease. I highly recommend her!

It was my first time seeing Dr. Dosantos, and I'm very happy he's taking care of my dog.
I was impressed by his highly professional demeanor and kindness.
The team is incredibly attentive, always available, very thoughtful and caring towards the animals… and their owners!! Thank you for taking such good care of my cat, you saved him!

Dr. Dos Santos is exceptional. His rapport with animals is unparalleled, and his good humor is truly appreciated. My cat (a Bengal with a very strong personality) isn't easily handled during a routine blood test, and they were perfect at getting the necessary information. They are quick, efficient, and extremely professional. I recommend them a thousand times over.
They were the veterinary provider for our dog Sandy for the three years we lived in Paris. The vets there are extremely caring, patient and accessible. They were wonderful - I'll miss them!
Highly qualified staff, and above all, very empathetic.
Well done to the whole team for their kindness and efficiency.

Aïko, my little Chihuahua, was pampered during his neutering. The team was serious, professional, and competent, yet welcoming and friendly. A huge thank you! You have earned my complete trust with my little dogs!

Excellent service, very pleasant clinic, Dr. Dos Santos 10/10!

Thank you!
Isaac
Very good. Lucille was kind and attentive. She gave us good advice. For a first time, it was great.

For several years now, we've entrusted our animals to Vétos Parisiens—one dog and five cats. The entire team is fantastic. Both the veterinarians and veterinary assistants demonstrate impeccable professionalism, genuine gentleness with the animals, and attentive listening to the owners. It's clear that the well-being of their furry patients, big and small, is their top priority. A clinic in which we have complete confidence.

Excellent clinic, and Dr. Ciup is an excellent veterinarian.

Her genuine expertise allowed her to provide our diabetic dog, Mezzo, with a thorough diagnosis and appropriate care.
His health has significantly improved, whereas he was in a very critical condition last December when Dr. Ciup took him in.
Thank you to her and all the staff at this clinic.

The team is always attentive and caring. I would like to give special mention to Dr. Ciup, who treats my animals with great kindness and competence.
I highly recommend this practice.
Available, friendly, competent

I just left the clinic after my 10-week-old Miniature American Shepherd puppy received his booster vaccination. Dr. Arielle Ciup was wonderful; she took the time to answer our (many) questions and was very gentle with my dog. I'm so glad I found this clinic, which now has one more loyal customer.
Excellent clinic. The vets and assistants are super professional and friendly.
Very kind and sympathetic with my 20 yr old (!) corgi. À good experience for both my dog and me.
A very warm welcome, the veterinarians are professional. No waiting time. The place is very peaceful. Thank you very much to the whole team.

The initial diagnosis was incorrect, and another vet confirmed it. It only cost me €125 instead of €400! And my dog ​​avoided what they considered an unnecessary operation.

My uncle, on the other hand, had to pay €380 for his dog's teeth cleaning instead of the €280 quoted! The excuse was that the cleaning took longer and was more complicated than expected... money is everything at this clinic!

It's a real blessing to have a vet like Dr. Dos Santos, not only kind, gentle, and attentive, but excellent!

Signed, Tintin the Fox -)

I wholeheartedly recommend this veterinary clinic. Dr. Dos Santos is simply the best veterinarian I have ever met. Not only was he able to identify and resolve a problem my dog, Nugget, had been struggling with for over a year, but he did so with remarkable professionalism and compassion.

Beyond his expertise, he is a deeply humane, attentive, reassuring, and passionate person. From the moment you walk through the clinic door, you feel comfortable, almost at home, which is incredibly valuable during stressful times.

A huge thank you to him for his dedication and professionalism. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. 💌🩵

Honestly, they're horrible people. They pretend to care about your animals, but deep down, they're only in it to rip people off and charge exorbitant prices for everything. The price is based on your appearance. I have a friend with the same breed of cat; we had the same neutering done, but there was a €200 price difference. Plus, the vet gave her a fake claim form so she could get reimbursed, telling her insurance company it was for a cat that was violent (which it wasn't), and not for me. Anyway, I won't even go into the medical errors, the misdiagnosis, and the way they speak, which is far from acceptable. So, STAY AWAY!!!!!!!!!!!
Deplorable... I advise you against going to these doctors; they are completely unprofessional and very bad.

Catastrophic, avoid at all costs. I won't even go into detail, but there were so many mistakes that could have had very serious consequences for my dog, and to top it all off, a complete lack of professionalism.

She still took the time to thoroughly examine my dog ​​and ask me many questions about his condition to find the cause. The whole team was lovely and reassuring; I highly recommend them!

Thank you to the two veterinarians I saw for their kindness and the care they gave my Lilie.

Unfortunately, my experience at this veterinary clinic was extremely unpleasant. When making the appointment and before the procedure, I inquired about the cost of the necessary services; I was given a quote of €286, exactly the amount I had anticipated.

However, during the examination, the veterinarian added several tests to the bill without informing me or obtaining my consent. When I asked for an explanation regarding this significant increase, I was told it was a "mistake by an assistant," who had supposedly misinterpreted the initial information.

Ultimately, I found myself in a difficult situation: the bill turned out to be higher than both the initial quote and the stated price. I believe this type of situation should be discussed beforehand, and it is essential to obtain the client's consent for any additional procedures. Transparency and honesty regarding costs are fundamental to quality care, especially when it comes to animal health.

I was charged for a dressing change a few days after my cat's spaying, and it was even a wobbly one. She had to go to the emergency vet the day after the operation because the bandage, made of woven strips, kept tearing. My cat could barely breathe because it was so tightly wrapped. All this for €400, including medication (which was completely unnecessary, just to inflate the bill).

I completely agree with "Esther" that the staff at this clinic tend to take better care of the animals of wealthy people. And everything else she said is true. Zero follow-up. They pretend to love animals just to inflate the bill in the end.
Definitely avoid this place. They'll do anything to charge you for every little thing. I'll never go back.

At the end of March, I had a tumor removed from my cat's head. Before the operation, to avoid multiple anesthetics, they suggested I have ultrasounds done to check that the tumor hadn't spread internally. Fine, I love my pet more than anything and I trusted them. When I picked up my cat, they explained that the images weren't clear, so biopsies had been taken from key organs (including the spleen). Fine again, but I was extremely stressed about the consequences of these biopsies. I waited in utter anguish for the results. When Dr. Thorel contacted me again on a Friday, she told me the results were bad. There was spread to the spleen, and we had to act quickly. She proposed radiation therapy to the area where the tumor had been removed, adding chemotherapy, and removing the spleen early the following week. I was devastated. I asked for the results and discovered that the tumor was low-grade and the mitotic index was very low, which is actually a good sign (and yes, I had to do some research to stop crying after the diagnosis). Wanting to be absolutely sure, I consulted another clinic, paid for another complete workup, and the verdict was: no internal spread of the tumor. Two months of anguish and a lot of money spent. I'm puzzled because the clinic seems to have competent staff. But then why put me through all this and risk my pet's life? For money? I don't even want to think about the suffering my cat would have endured if I had followed the diagnosis. The most important thing is his good health. In conclusion, I advise you to always get a second opinion.

Following the clinic's response, here are some important points to bring to the readers' attention:

- Dr. Thoral did indeed propose a splenectomy in YOUR office and not elsewhere, not by her but by Dr. Dos Santos, she told me.

- Just because a new skin tumor appears doesn't mean organs should be removed without certainty of tumor spread! That was precisely the reason for your staging workup, namely to determine whether or not further treatments were necessary, wasn't it?

- The lab results absolutely did not indicate tumor spread. Since it seems you haven't fully read my comments, I'll clarify: the oncologist I consulted even contacted your lab, which clearly stated that the results contained no evidence of spread.

Regarding your advice for prompt treatment, I reiterate: I immediately contacted an oncology department, further tests were performed, and the results show no spread.

Dedication doesn't mean butchering animals, but rather, in case of doubt and before suggesting splenectomy, seeking advice from qualified specialists if one lacks the necessary expertise.

Disgusted as I am, I wasn't even expecting an apology from you for this misdiagnosis, but at least some honesty in presenting the facts. Another hope dashed.

We adopted a 2-year-old Pomsky. The vet guided us through every step and gave us all the feeding tips. An excellent vet—composed, calm, and efficient.
I highly recommend her!

I used this clinic between September 2024 and January 2025 for the care of my two female Persian cats.

With all reservations, go there if:

- You have a dog,

- You live in Paris (as the sign indicates, by the way), and even better, from the neighborhood.
Think twice before going if:

- You have a cat,

- You're not from the area.

Among other things, despite the "Cat friendly" label (which, admittedly, is awarded to veterinary clinics based on self-declaration) dating from November 2023, there is no separation between cats and dogs, neither at reception (cats on the left, dogs on the right) in my experience, nor in the area where the kennels are located, in case of hospitalization (for surgery or otherwise), according to a video posted on Instagram.

As I work with dogs myself, I always have recommended Christophe to all my clients and they have always been as equally impressed. Above all and most importantly, my dog loves him.

He’s v knowledgeable and offered solutions that the previous vet we’d gone to hadn’t considered. He also made the insurance part super easy and quick by processing the claim from his computer : I got an email from the insurer this morning to say the request was being processed (my previous vet was working with paper claims which meant I wouldn’t get a reimbursement for at least 2-3 weeks).

All in all, great and modern clinic with state of the art equipment, super friendly staff and a genuinely great vet.
